# setecho

Changes the local echo status of Tera Term.

```ttl
setecho <echo flag>
```

## Remarks

If &lt;echo flag&gt; is non-zero, the local echo is turned on.
If &lt;echo flag&gt; is zero, the local echo is turned off.

## Example

```ttl
; local echo on
setecho 1
```
